test a different weighting scheme on the full pool to see if softmax_neg_error improves over inverse_error.
test a simple mean combination on the full pool to see if a non-weighted average beats the weighted best, given moderate ranking stability and strong trend dominance.
Try a DBA weighted combination on the full pool, motivated by the trend-dominated regime and moderate ranking stability.
Explore a forward‑selection based weighting (weights_forward) on the full pool to see if an adaptive greedy scheme improves over static softmax.
The series is trend-dominated with high predictability; a trimmed mean may reduce influence of outliers/weak models while still aggregating many.
The series is trend dominated with moderate ranking stability; a weighted combo on the smaller, highly ranked pool4 may yield better balance.
Test a per‑horizon weighted scheme on the full pool to see if the top‑3 mean per step improves over global weighting.
Test a new weighted scheme on the full pool using the w5 handle to see if a different weight calibration improves over the current leader, given the trend-dominated, high predictability series.
Try a simple median combination on the smaller, decorrelated pool4 to see if a robust non‑weighted method beats the weighted baseline.
use inverse_error weights on full pool

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w6' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.6463. Series context: trend strength 0.984 and seasonal strength 0.0; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.462); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 21.472.
